products.prep:
1. Heat oven to 350°F. Spray bottom and sides of 13x9-inch pan with cooking spray.
  2. Make sugar cookie dough as directed on pouch for drop cookies. Stir in ¼ cup of the candy sprinkles. Press dough evenly in bottom of pan.
  3. Make double chocolate chunk cookie dough as directed on pouch. Drop dough by spoonfuls over sugar cookie dough. Using metal spatula, evenly spread dough to cover sugar cookie dough layer. Sprinkle remaining 2 tablespoons candy sprinkles over top.
  4. Bake 30 to 34 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean and edges are set. Cool completely on cooling rack, about 2 hours.
  5. In small microwaveable bowl, microwave chocolate chips uncovered on High 30 to 60 seconds, stirring halfway through, until chips can be stirred smooth. Spoon into resealable food-storage plastic bag; partially seal bag. Cut small tip from corner of bag. Squeeze bag to pipe over top of bar.
  6. Let stand about 2 hours or until chocolate is set. Cut into 6 rows by 4 rows.

products.prep:
Stove-Top Directions

1 stir STIR Sauce Mix, 1 1/2 cups hot water, 2/3 cup milk, 2 tablespoons butter and Potatoes in 2-quart saucepan. Heat just to boiling, stirring occasionally.

Watch carefully to avoid boilover.

2 reduce REDUCE heat. Cover; simmer about 25 minutes, stirring often, until tender (sauce will thicken).

YOU WILL NEED:

1 1/2 Cups Boiling Water

2/3 Cup Milk

2 Tablespoons Butter

Oven Directions

1 heat HEAT oven to 425°F. Stir Sauce Mix, boiling water, milk and butter with whisk in 1 1/2-quart casserole dish. Stir in Potatoes.

2 bake BAKE uncovered about 35 minutes or until top is golden brown and potatoes are tender (sauce will thicken).

BAKING TIPS:

For 2 boxes, double all ingredients; bake in 3-quart casserole dish about 40 minutes at 425°F.

Bake potatoes and roast meat at same time:

325°F about 60 minutes

350°F about 50 minutes

375°F about 45 minutes

Microwave Directions

1 stir STIR Sauce Mix, 2 cups hot water, 2/3 cup milk, 2 tablespoons butter and Potatoes in 2 1/2-quart microwavable casserole dish.

2 microwave MICROWAVE uncovered on High 18 to 23 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until tender (sauce will thicken). CAUTION: HOT!

Make It Like Betty

Stir 1/2 teaspoon onion powder into potato mixture before baking. Top baked Scalloped Potatoes with 1 cup crispy fried onions and 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley before serving.

INTENSE TASTE: Seasoned with robust garlic flavor, it's a fan-favorite snack the whole family will enjoy

CRAFTED WITH TRADITION: This crowd-pleasing rye snack is based on a signature Gardetto family recipe

GARDETTO'S SPECIALTY: Crafted with you in mind, featuring a snack of only your favorite crunchy, double roasted garlic rye chips

CONTAINS: Twelve 8 oz snack bags of Gardetto's Special Request Garlic Rye Chips
products.ingredients: Enriched Flour (wheat flour, niacin, iron, riboflavin, thiamin mononitrate, folic acid), Vegetable Oil (high oleic canola, high oleic soybean, high oleic sunflower, palm, fractionated palm, palm olein and/or soybean), Rye Flour, Sugar, Salt. Contains 2% or less of: Yeast, Monosodium Glutamate, Maltodextrin, Dried Worcestershire Sauce (vinegar, molasses, corn syrup, salt, caramel color, garlic powder, sugar, spice, tamarind, natural flavor), Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Fumaric Acid, Spice, Sodium Diacetate, Disodium Inosinate, Disodium Guanylate, Caramel Color. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
products.features:

  1. Roasted rye chips with bold garlic seasoning

  3. Crunchy and hearty texture

  6. Comes in 8 oz bags (pack of 12)

Benefits

  1. Rich garlic flavor for a bold taste experience
  2. Crunchy texture satisfies snack cravings
  3. Convenient and portable for on-the-go snacking
  4. Trusted brand with long-standing heritage
  5. Ideal for parties, road trips, or quick munching
  6. Great long shelf life
